criteria: Cultural threads are typed, sourced relationships. They are not a physical itinerary. A broad territory is not promoted to a city. No birthplace, nationality, title or genre is inferred as musical heritage.

253.subject: Luke Vibert
253.label: Cornwall
253.note: Vibert's official biography describes growing up and starting his music in Cornwall; his present London base is separate. Cornwall is a regional musical-development association, not the recording location of Arcadia.

338.relation: Musical roots and production scene in
338.subject: Roni Size
338.label: Bristol
338.note: Publisher biography documents the Bristol youth-club, sound-system and early production roots of Roni Size. This does not claim that Sing was recorded in Bristol or that Jocelyn Brown shares this origin.

391.relation: Experimental and improvisational music career in
391.subject: David Toop
391.label: London
391.note: CCCB documents Toop's part in London Musicians' Collective and London experimental music. This is Toop's scene association only, not Max Eastley's origin or their recording site.

651.relation: Early sound-system and drum-and-bass career developed in
651.subject: Digital
651.label: Ipswich
651.note: RBMA interview with Steve Carr documents his Ipswich sound-system background and early production. Does not establish studio of One Ton.

1665.subject: DJ Deeon
1665.label: Chicago
1665.note: AllMusic documents Deeon's Chicago South Side house parties, Dance Mania releases and early ghetto-house production. This is a scene history, not a studio or location of the owned pressing.

1749.subject: King Britt
1749.label: Philadelphia
1749.note: Pew documents Philadelphia as the root of Britt's music inspiration and his city collaborators. No geographic claim for Oba Funke or Bush Workout recording.

2053.subject: DJ Pierre
2053.label: Chicago
2053.note: The artist biography identifies Pierre as a Chicago house pioneer and Phuture co-founder. This is formative scene geography, not a recording claim for Acid 88 Volume III.

2173.subject: Renegade / Ray Keith
2173.label: Essex
2173.note: DJ Mag identifies Ray Keith as an Essex jungle pioneer recording under the Renegade alias. The same Renegade's Dark Soldier Part 1 & 2 release is independently indexed at DNBHQ; an Essex scene association, not this record's studio.

4281.subject: Ellen Allien
4281.label: Berlin
4281.note: BPitch documents Allien's Berlin techno career and scene-building. This is an artist association, not the recording location of Turn Off Your Mind.

13398.relation: Estonian underground electronic music scene in
13398.subject: Ajukaja
13398.label: Tallinn
13398.note: Resident Advisor calls Ajukaja and Ats part of Tallinn's electronic underground, documenting their label and studio work. This is the matching Ajukaja participant's scene association, not an assertion that Benga Benga was recorded in Tallinn.

14109.subject: Potential Bad Boy
14109.label: United Kingdom
14109.note: Resident Advisor lists this jungle producer in the UK; London gigs are not evidence of a London production base.

14886.subject: Cosmic Force
14886.label: Netherlands
14886.note: Resident Advisor identifies Ben Spaander/Cosmic Force, describes his early mixtape making and lists the Netherlands as location. Broad artist base only; no studio or city inferred.

16483.relation: Early DJ career and electronic scene in
16483.subject: Alex Neri
16483.label: Tuscany
16483.note: Artist biography documents Neri's early DJ work across Tuscany and Florence-area club/label collaborations. Regional formative scene; point is representative of Tuscany, not a studio.

16776.subject: Mono Junk
16776.label: Turku
16776.note: RA identifies Kimmo Rapatti as Mono Junk, based in Turku; Imatra birthplace not promoted to electronic music origin. Base may differ from historical studio.

17217.subject: Shinichi Atobe
17217.label: Saitama
17217.note: Japanese music distributor biography identifies Saitama as Atobe's base and explicitly lists World (2016). A musical base, not a specific recording studio.

34453.subject: Malente
34453.label: Germany
34453.note: Resident Advisor lists the artist's location as Germany. Country-level artist association only; the countries of Mashed Up Funk pressings are separate release-market facts. No city inferred.

35328.subject: Sun Ra
35328.label: Chicago
35328.note: A connection through the ensemble Sun Ra founded. It does not identify where this particular record was made.

53036.relation: Early post-punk musical career associated with
53036.subject: Vivien Goldman
53036.label: London
53036.note: Goldman's official biography identifies her as a Londoner, her role in the 1970s British music press and early-1980s post-punk recordings. London is a biographical and cultural association, not a proven recording location for Resolutionary's tracks.

180280.subject: Roberto Musci
180280.label: Milan
180280.note: Musci's own biography describes his Milan base and global field-recording practice. Milan is an artist base; no claim about recordings on Urban And Tribal Portraits or collaborator Giovanni Venosta.

247674.subject: Fatima Yamaha
247674.label: Netherlands
247674.note: RA identifies Bas Bron and Netherlands location. Country-level artist base only; Fatima Yamaha's fictional persona biography is not treated as geographic identity.

298930.subject: B.B. Seaton
298930.label: Kingston
298930.note: Studio One/The Gaylads biography documents Seaton as a Kingston-born singer and his early Kingston-area musical career. This is an artist musical association, not a recording location of this owned single.

328543.relation: House DJ and label career associated with
328543.subject: Jus-Ed
328543.label: Bridgeport
328543.note: Resident Advisor DJ biography identifies Bridgeport, Connecticut as his home and describes his long-running underground house DJ career. Not a recording location.

417641.subject: Morphosis / Rabih Beaini
417641.label: Lebanon
417641.note: Beaini's own label documents starting his DJ career in Lebanon before moving to Italy in 1996 and Berlin in 2012. This is a historical artist musical association, not any record's recording site.

466022.relation: House and experimental techno career developed in
466022.subject: Jamal Moss
466022.label: Chicago
466022.note: Jamal Moss is identified as Hieroglyphic Being and his Chicago parties, radio and production scene documented. Artist association, not Ginger Snaps studio.

575604.subject: Kassem Mosse
575604.label: Leipzig
575604.note: AllMusic identifies Gunnar Wendel/Kassem Mosse as Leipzig-based. This is the collaborator's base on Saboten, not FIT Siegel's base or a recording address.

663348.relation: Electronic DJ and production career from
663348.subject: Sano
663348.label: Medellín
663348.note: RA identifies Sebastián Hoyos as producer from Medellín, now resident in Barcelona. Medellín is artist's scene association, not Latino Body Music recording site.

691770.subject: André Kronert
691770.label: Germany
691770.note: Resident Advisor documents the exact Ain't No Funny Music release and lists Germany as location. Only national precision; festival appearances do not establish hometown.

734504.relation: Musical career and house scene in
734504.subject: San Proper
734504.label: Amsterdam
734504.note: Resident Advisor documents San Proper's sustained Amsterdam scene involvement, Rush Hour and Dekmantel releases. Artist association only; not a studio for either owned record.

869854.subject: Madteo
869854.label: New York City
869854.note: RA identifies Matteo Ruzzon as Italian-born and New York-based; source distinguishes birthplace from musical base. Does not imply Insider was recorded in New York.

1045249.relation: Discovered house and began DJ career in
1045249.subject: Mr Raoul K
1045249.label: Hamburg
1045249.note: ADE biography documents moving from Ivory Coast to Hamburg in 1992, developing a house/techno interest there and later making a home studio in Lübeck. Hamburg is formative scene, not location of Wind Of Goree recording.

1158290.relation: Formative DJ and record culture in
1158290.subject: DJ Sotofett
1158290.label: Moss
1158290.note: Mixmag's interview details growing up in Moss, Norway, local record-store influences and founding Sex Tags Mania. Does not imply that either collaboration was recorded there.

1181868.subject: Bottin
1181868.label: Venice
1181868.note: Artist/label biography documents Guglielmo Bottin's Venice base and creative work. No claim about this specific 12-inch's recording, remix sources or manufacturing.

1488101.relation: Formative hardcore and jungle career in
1488101.subject: Coco Bryce
1488101.label: Breda
1488101.note: DJ Mag interviews Yoël Bego about growing up in Breda and learning to DJ in the local hardcore scene. This does not locate the Hold The Line studio.

1658423.relation: Underground DJ and label culture from
1658423.subject: DJ Fett Burger
1658423.label: Moss
1658423.note: Artist's own website describes the producer as from Moss and the Sex Tags label projects. It does not locate the Red Scorpions collaboration recording or DJ Speckgürtel.

1767407.subject: Psychemagik
1767407.label: United Kingdom
1767407.note: Resident Advisor locates the production/remix duo in the UK. No city or location for individual re-edited tracks is inferred.

1932807.subject: Cygnus
1932807.label: United States
1932807.note: Resident Advisor identifies Phillip Washington as Cygnus and lists US location. Dallas/Fort Worth gigging is not proof of his recording studio.

2406747.relation: Early electronic production career based in
2406747.subject: Octo Octa
2406747.label: Brooklyn
2406747.note: Contemporaneous artist biography calls Maya Bouldry-Morrison Brooklyn-based in her early EP period. Historic base only; not claimed as current address or Adrift studio.

2480495.subject: Powell
2480495.label: London
2480495.note: AllMusic identifies Oscar Powell's London base and Diagonal label. The city is a career base, not documented recording location of Body Music EP.

2576696.subject: Frits Wentink
2576696.label: Amsterdam
2576696.note: The artist's own Bandcamp profile identifies Amsterdam as his location. This is an artist base, not proof of where BODOMRGWLD01 was recorded.

2712259.relation: Electronic music career and club residency in
2712259.subject: Helena Hauff
2712259.label: Hamburg
2712259.note: Artist representation documents hometown Hamburg and Golden Pudel residency, not where Have You Been There was recorded.

3192367.subject: Not Waving
3192367.label: London
3192367.note: AllMusic documents London-based Alessio Natalizia forming the Not Waving project following Walls; Italian origin is not used as a substitute for musical base.

4447121.subject: Yoshinori Hayashi
4447121.label: Japan
4447121.note: Resident Advisor identifies the electronic artist's Japanese location and work. Tokyo gigs are not interpreted as residence or recording.

5793123.subject: Altın Gün
5793123.label: Amsterdam
5793123.note: The album notes identify the band with Amsterdam. This is its musical base, not a recording-location claim.

6235154.relation: Production training and underground house scene in
6235154.subject: FIT Siegel
6235154.label: Detroit
6235154.note: Artist biography describes studies with Underground Resistance and his active Detroit studio and music distribution. For Saboten it pertains to FIT only, not Kassem Mosse.

6584747.relation: DJ career and underground scene developed in
6584747.subject: Yousuke Yukimatsu
6584747.label: Osaka
6584747.note: Mixmag's artist interview documents his early Osaka and nearby Kobe DJ work. Osaka is the artist's formative musical scene, not the mix compilation's recording site or a current permanent base.

7212008.subject: Workforce
7212008.label: United Kingdom
7212008.note: Resident Advisor identifies Workforce as Jack Stevens, previously SpectraSoul, and locates him in the UK. No city inferred from gigs.

11758168.subject: On
11758168.label: Turkey
11758168.note: The label describes interpretations of traditional Turkish folk songs. The country marker represents a repertoire connection, not one exact place of origin for every song.

12343877.subject: Disco 3000
12343877.label: Milan
12343877.note: Art Yard documents the Milan concert recording. This session location remains separate from Sun Ra’s Chicago ensemble connection.
